description: He wears a cream long fine linen tunic with gold-tan geometric collar, front, cuff and hem borders beneath a long dark brown patterned open robe with wide sleeves and rich gold worked edging. A broad gold-brown woven sash wraps the waist with a long patterned fringed hanging end. Low brown leather boots with gold-tan worked trim show beneath the tunic. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
